title: 章鱼有三个心脏 · 素材
subtitle: 给对比页用的单体素材
style: children's picture book illustration, soft chalk pastel with velvety grain and smudged blended edges, deep sea blue, coral red and warm sand

pages.scene: One single octopus with a large rounded head and eight long arms trailing behind it, seen from the side facing left, its whole body inside the picture. The background is one flat cream colour of a single even tone that fills the whole picture right out to all four edges. The object floats on this flat colour: it casts no shadow and rests on no ground, and there is no darker patch, wash, puddle, base, line or platform of any kind underneath it. There is no sky, no horizon, no clouds and no scenery of any kind behind it: the cream colour is the only thing behind the object, exactly as if the object had been cut out and laid on blank paper.
